Make thin omelettes; roll and slice into ribbons.
Fry garlic and shrimp paste in oil 1 min; add cold rice; toss 4 min until evenly coated and hot (≥75 °C).

Peel; pound coarsely in a mortar.
Season with fish sauce, lime and salt; fold in coriander. It should be smoky, hot and juicy.

Add bruised lemongrass, galangal, charred shallots and lime leaves 15 min.

Fry beef in oil until it changes colour; add onion, potato, carrot and shirataki.

Bring water, sake, mirin, sugar and sliced ginger to the boil; lay in fish skin-side up; cover with otoshibuta; simmer 6 min.
Dissolve miso in some liquid; add; simmer 5 min, spooning over, until glossy; core ≥63 °C.

Cut fish into pieces; pour boiling water over; rinse off blood and scales in cold water.
Simmer daikon, fish, water, sake and ginger 10 min under otoshibuta; skim.
Add sugar, mirin, then soy; simmer 30 min until daikon is amber; core ≥63 °C.
Serve with thin ginger needles and yuzu zest.

Fry at 170 °C 5–6 min; core ≥63 °C; rest 2 min; slice in 6.
Per portion in an oyakodon pan: 80 ml warishita (dashi, soy, mirin, sugar) and 60 g sliced onion; simmer 2 min; add cutlet; pour over 2 beaten eggs; cover 40 s until just set.

Score prawns underneath to straighten. Slice kabocha and lotus 6 mm.

Dust items in flour; dip; fry at 175 °C (vegetables 2–3 min, prawns 1.5 min); prawn core ≥63 °C.

Make thin omelettes (kinshi tamago); slice into fine threads. Julienne ham and cucumber; blanch sprouts 30 s and chill; cut tomato wedges.

Fry onion in butter; add mince 5 min until cooked through; season with salt, pepper, sugar and soy.

Knead minces with salt until sticky; add onion, soaked panko, egg, pepper and nutmeg; shape 130 g patties.

Fry at 165 °C 6–7 min until deep golden; core ≥75 °C; rest 2 min (juices run).

Sear in oil 2 min per side; cover with a splash of water and steam 8 min over low heat; core ≥75 °C.

Thicken lightly with starch slurry (helps the egg float in clouds).

Sear beef in batches in very hot oil 1 min; remove.
Fry garlic, onion and pepper strips 1 min.
